FROZEN BUILD13 RECOVERY EXECUTION / PRIVATE TEST-TOOL PLAN —2026-10-27

Existing .3 only; no new issue, driver implementation, install, original-source decompile, transport/ring/calendar/clock/recovery/QoS change, mapping/calibration/LED-policy change or security setting. Same signed0.2.8/build13 sourcee61aa5ab. Fresh12hashes/signatures/SIP and soleowner72936/device128/G1/running48k verified. User ready with guitar/headphones, low level, all controls released/heel. GR6 currently running known wah test48k128.

Order: A) one actual awake audio Stop/Start by quitting Guitar Rig (not rack bypass/mute), waiting10s and reopening the same preset, while persistent nativeMIDI and raw-native/status/log observers continue. Require actual connected-idle interval flags1/running0 then runningflags3/48k, same generation/owner, no unexpected errors or switchCCs while untouched. Then fresh switch1on/sweep/off and user clear audio/LED/pedal confirmation, exact2CC80 and freshCC4. B) sleep/wake with audio+MIDI and wah/LED1on: user presses onceon, sleeps normally/wakes, waits10s untouched; record physicalLED/wah state, then one freshpress off+pedalsweep. Sleep may retain or replace USBcohort; no phantom switchCC in quiet transition, no MIDI port refresh/GR6 relaunch/LED reset workaround. C) released-switch USB: fromoff pressonceon/release, unplug5s/reconnect, wait10s untouched, confirm retainedwah/LED1on; then freshpress off+pedalsweep. D) held-switch USB: fromoff pressonceon and hold through unplug5s/reconnect10s; confirmstillheld/retainedon, then release (noevent) and one freshpress off+pedalsweep. SameMIDI monitor throughout humanreplies; cumulative snapshots before/after each transition/action. Expected switchCC1=80 and other7=81,82,83,76,77,78,79. Quiet transition phantom criteria concern switchCCs, not analogCC4 noise. Exact history/cachedsnapshot not substituted for freshphysicalactions. Keep allLEDs off at end by ordinary physicalaction; no correctivefeedback during automatic-recovery judgement.

Raw transition observer: a new ignored .build/native/build13-recovery/tools/native-state-watch.c, minimal derivative of the previously reviewed rate-watch: DEVICE argument only; read-only rk3_native_copy_info and publicnominalrate each100ms, print raw tick+walltime/status/flags/G/version/error/native/publicrate; report failed/disconnected states instead of exiting, no automatic success verdict, no setter/start/reset/retry/USB/MIDI writes. SIGINT/SIGTERM terminatecleanly. Offline strictARM compile and pure argument/finite serialization fixtures +independentreview before liveuse. Root classifies every row by explicit phase. Steady/awake require version1/status0/flags1or3 asphase/rate48000/error0/sameG. Planned sleep/USB windows may contain no-device/not-open/aborted/not-ready or unavailableproperty states, recorded literally; never suppress IsoTooOld, unrelatedfaults or postrecovery errors. SDK IOReturn constants only if needed to classify literal observed values, no broadnewanalysis. User wait10s recovery is checked against actual healthy rows; root allows atmost30s after reported reconnection/wake for healthy stable state (no reconnect/retry). If no recovery, retainfailure andstopaffectedtest. USB sameowner requiresnewconnectedgeneration>previous, not exact+1. SleepmayretainoradvanceG; anyownerchange mustberecorded andno duplicateowner permitted; do not silently reuseoldlogPID. Observe one stable10s healthy posttransition before freshactions where data permits.

Persistent observers: reused frozen native MIDI monitor; new rawstatewatch; existing owner error/fault/timing logstream. Pin sources/binaries/argv/PIDs, rootsnapshots/events/time, eachhumananswer. No secondUSBowner or standaloneaudiblemonitor whileGR6runs. Stop at first unexpected transport/process/useraudio/control fault; preserveevidence, no repair/retry/diagnosticexpansion. Expected disconnect observations remain inlogs; classify individually, not blanketignored. User actions maytake time, so no45s recorder expiry. Lowheadphones before anynewaudibleclient. No hiddenpower/sleep/security commands: user performs sleep/USB, and normalappquit/reopen. Native audio test that directly claimsUSB is excluded.

E) smallest private standardCoreAudio direction-helper, OFFLINE prepared/reviewed in parallel, only then one bounded silent run after GR6 quits and cleanidle established. .build/native/build13-recovery/tools/direction-recovery.c, no productioncode. Reuse existing public UID/nativeinfo lookup/health and128buffer patterns. Two actual AudioDeviceIOProcIDs configured/readback using SDK kAudioDevicePropertyIOProcStreamUsage per complete one-stream direction, selected returnedID in mIOProc: input(1,0), output(0,1). Null disabled direction buffers mustbeverified in actual callbacks, stereoFloat32/128 geometry/finite timestamps/counters; output allzeros, no tones/gain/monitor/testring. Keep inputID running, startoutput then stop/restart outputID atmost3times, while inputcount/currentclock advances and stoppedoutput count quiescent. At each naturalstop read OUTPUT stream kAudioStreamPropertyIsActive WITHOUT setting it. Require actualglobalinactive if claiming NI last-output ring-clear boundary. If outputremainsactive, finishsafe cleanup and record CLIENT_DIRECTION_ONLY / NI_LAST_OUTPUT_UNPROVEN, notPASS, no forcingglobalstreamproperty ordriverfix. No nonzeroPCM stale-replay proof fromsilence; recordexplicitlimitation. If helper admission/offline or publicboundary fails, reportexactgap; do notinventbackend/API. No separate fullawakecycle inhelper (gateAalreadydoesactualGR6StopStart), noextra diagnostic run or retries. Bound eachphase<=5s (total<=60s), cleanup output theninput and destroyIDs; failuresstopsequence, recordallnative/clock/count/IsActive/callstatuses. Allappclients mustbeclosed/idle before claimlastoutput; preserve128hosttestsetting; no sample-rate setter. Sourceofflinefixtures+strictcompile+independentreview beforeliverun. Rootprivateplan sets this exact scope before coding; implementation agent must not widen.

Finish requested recovery subset with exact PASS/FAIL/unvalidated per gate and proof limits, not wholeM1/M2/M3. No DIN/toe/external/latency/gain/reinstall/extra stability inthis task. Compact Build13RecoveryValidation record, independent rawrecordreview, update existing Beads +terminalhandoff, passiveexportactiveonly/preserveprimaryindex113d42992a0ee90acfb640fc694b469abba536a6, Gitpullrebase/push and separateDoltpush. GuitarRig mayremainavailable at end after judgement; any manualreopen needed for testhelper setup isnotautomaticUSBrecovery evidence.

Agent prematurely stopped segment1 on apparentzero-message gap; finaldump containedCC80oneon+1238pedalmessages. This initialgap diagnosis wascorrected, notblamedondriver. Allsegment1 logs/hashes and exits retained.

A freshsegment2 baseline wasrequiredbeforethevalidroot-controlledA2 cycle. InitialFinished waslaterphysicallyclarifiedasLEDstillon/pedalawayheel; usercompletedreturn and baselinecounts2/off+fullrange/heel wereverified.
FirstB useractionwaslock/displayoff, explicitlyclarified andnotacceptedassleep. ActualAppleMenuSleepB2 wasthen corroborated byOSrecord+39.76s samplinggap.

No new issue/planningcard or unrelated original-binary/decompilation/backend investigation. Only ignored private diagnostic helpers and portable evidence/Beads records added.
limits: Fresh postwake control delivery failed the requested check, but the failing layer/cause is not determined. Do not infer a particular USB, CoreMIDI, cached-object, mapper or host fault from this record.

Audio/native return and userreports are separate from missingMIDI/hostwahoff evidence. Userreportedoff/working is preserved literally; physicalLEDoff and GUIpoweron/recorderlast127 are also preserved, not silently reconciled.

Raw observer reads nativeinfo and nominalrate sequentially, not an atomic cohort snapshot. Strictadvancing rawticks are observerliveness, not proof of same-active-client audio clock or continuous PCM.
No new PCM recording, true-loopback latency or nonzero stale-replay proof. Directionhelper neverran; itsstandardAPI masks/naturalIsActive check and proof limits are offlinepreparation only.
OSpowerackwarnings were recorded, not causallyattributed. Actualsleep42s is thekernelrecord; requested60sundisturbed includednotificationtime andisnotclaimedas60sactualsleep.

MIDI monitor provides cumulative counts/extrema/latestvalues and SIGUSR1 snapshots, not per-event timestamps. Initialcoordination mistakes andobserversegmentgap are explicit; validA2 uses provenbefore/afterdata inonesegment.
BaselineCC4range0..127 was captured; freshpost-A2movement iscountdelta46 plususerfullsweep, not isolated postrestart extrema. Post-sleep movementcountdidnotincrease.
FinalfreshlookupAudioObjectID126 differsfrominitial128/rawobserverargument; IDs andvalidresponsesareobservationsonly, not a provenre-enumeration orcause.

USB released/held recovery andlastoutputcycles were deferred at firstactualpost-sleepfailure, notpassed or silentlyinferredfrompriorbuilds. Prior13silent/physicalpasses remain separate historical acceptance subsets.
BroaderM1/M2/M3/fulloriginalNIfunctionality remain incomplete. Nextwork mustbe narrowlyplanned inexistingdeliveryBeads beforecode, preservingNIaudio timing/recovery andSIP.

The recorder accepts only explicit0xB0 channel1CC triples from the selectednativeController source. No expectedCC80OFF/CC4movement was observed; this does not establish absence of allMIDI, otherchannels/statuses/running-status/DIN orUSBreports.

B2 recorded count5 unchanged is not reliable phantom-event exclusion afterwake, because subsequent confirmedphysicalactions were not corroborated by freshmessages. Retainedwah/LEDuserstate and actualpowertransition pass separately; overallMIDIrecoverydoesnotpass.
